button.label: Update Section Progress
button.supertip: Show section names inside a segmented progress bar and fill each section according to slide progress.

button.label: Remove Section Progress
button.supertip: Remove the section progress elements created by PPT Tools from the active presentation.

button.label: Export Notes to Markdown
button.supertip: Choose a folder and export all slide notes to one UTF-8 Markdown file.

button.label: Load Notes from Markdown
button.supertip: Choose a UTF-8 Markdown file and load each # Slide N block into the corresponding slide notes.

button.label: Code Prettier
button.supertip: Open the Code Prettier editor to format code and insert it into the slide as editable, syntax-highlighted text. Select an inserted code block first to edit it.
